ModMetaData.name: Wardrobe
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Outfit routines: colonists change into task gear from a wardrobe stockpile, then restore what they wore.
MVP - Wardrobe main tab (Assign-adjacent): per-colonist rules for Sleep, Cooking, Doctor, and Animals/Handling. - Pick a stockpile as the wardrobe and an apparel policy (outfit) per trigger. - On trigger: path to the stockpile, swap conflicting layers, wear matching gear, snapshot the old clothes. - On exit: restore the snapshot. Optimize Apparel is suppressed while a routine is active.
Deferred: rituals, gravship, Anomaly, patient-as-surgery-target, dresser furniture.
Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Safe to add mid-save. Clear wardrobe rules before removing the mod.
